sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)

s = input()
qq = "QAQ"
arr = [[-1] * 4 for _ in range(len(s) + 1)]

def Q(m, n):
    if arr[n][m] != -1:
        return arr[n][m]
    if m == 0:
        return 1
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    i = 0
    j = 0
    if qq[m - 1] == s[n - 1]:
        i = Q(m - 1, n - 1)
    j = Q(m, n - 1)
    arr[n][m] = i + j
    return i + j

print(Q(3, len(s)))
